nodes.description: mapping(address=>Limit) public allowed - whitelist mapping storing min/max limits per address
uint16 public chunkNr - counter of processed address packages, starts at 0
uint public recordNum - number of records processed, starts at 0
uint256 public controlSum - checksum accumulated over the stored records
bool public isSetupMode - setup mode flag, initialized to true
address public admin - privileged administrator address controlling the whitelist
string constant public VERSION = 0.3.2 - contract version identifier
function () { throw; } - explicitly unpayable fallback that always reverts
SantimentWhiteList() constructor - assigns admin = msg.sender at deployment
addPack(address[] addrs, uint24[] mins, uint24[] maxs, uint16 _chunkNr) external, guarded by setupOnly and adminOnly - adds an address package to the whitelist
start() public adminOnly - switches off setup mode by setting isSetupMode = false
setAdmin(address newAdmin) public adminOnly - transfers the admin role
modifier setupOnly - throws when isSetupMode is false
modifier adminOnly - throws when msg.sender is not the stored admin
msg.sender - attacker controllable external caller address used for authorization decisions
throw inside the fallback function - reverts any plain ether transfer to the contract
controlSum -= uint160(addr) + lim.min + lim.max - unchecked uint256 subtraction that can underflow
controlSum += uint160(addr) + min + max - unchecked uint256 addition that can overflow
chunkNr++ - unchecked uint16 increment that can overflow
recordNum += len - unchecked uint addition that can overflow
address[] addrs - array of addresses supplied to addPack
uint24[] mins - array of minimum limits supplied to addPack
uint24[] maxs - array of maximum limits supplied to addPack
uint16 _chunkNr - expected chunk number compared against chunkNr
address newAdmin - new administrator address passed to setAdmin
var len - addrs.length cached for loop bound and recordNum update
uint16 i - loop counter iterating over the package arrays
var addr - addrs[i], the address being inserted into the whitelist
var max - maxs[i], the maximum limit for the current address
var min - mins[i], the minimum limit for the current address
Limit lim - existing allowed[addr] record read before overwrite or deletion
